name: Website Status Checker Lite
author: guysoroka

sections.description:
Website Status Checker Lite is a simple and efficient WordPress plugin that allows you to monitor the availability and basic performance of your websites. The Lite version includes essential features for checking website uptime, but does not include advanced functionality such as automated checks, email alerts, or graphical performance reports.

Lite Version Features:
– Manual Website Check – Perform checks on demand
– Website Availability Check – See if your website is online
– Response Time Display – Know how fast your website loads
– Dashboard Widget – View website status from your WP Dashboard

Upgrade to Pro
Upgrade to the Pro version to unlock advanced features:
– Automated website checks
– Email alerts for downtime or slow response
– Detailed performance graphs
– Google PageSpeed Insights integration

👉 Click here to upgrade to Pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the website-status-checker-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Site Check” admin page to start monitoring your websites.
  4. Add your URLs and click “Run Check” to view status.
